title: symphytum davisii subsp. icaricum
intro: Symphytum davisii subsp. icaricum, commonly known as an endemic variety of Comfrey, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Symphytum davisii subsp. icaricum include promoting tissue repair, reducing pain and swelling, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include allantoin, rosmarinic acid, and other flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
